candidates.change_summary: Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance = msg.value;` so balance is overwritten instead of incremented.
Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance += _unlockTime;` so balance increases by unlock time instead of msg.value.
Remove the check `require(((acc.balance + msg.value) >= acc.balance));` by replacing it with an empty statement.
Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance -= msg.value;` so deposited amount is subtracted instead of added.
Change the balance check from acc.balance>=_am to acc.balance>_am, affecting withdrawal eligibility.
Change the balance check from acc.balance>=_am to acc.balance>=_am+1, so exact balance withdrawals revert.
Delete the reentrancy guard by removing the balance update before the external call.
Change the unlock time check from > to >=, allowing withdrawal exactly at unlockTime.
Change the MinSum check from >=' to '>', making it impossible to withdraw exactly MinSum balance.
